On the D side the top chord ends near C (under the wing roof); on the A side it runs past the support to the eave (1.00 on the S-04/A-04 plans, not dimensioned on this elevation).

Three section callouts: ridge อกไก่ 2C-150x50x20x3.2, top chord + verticals + diagonals 2C-100x50x20x3.2 (one callout, three leaders), bottom chord อะเส 2C-150x50x20x3.2 — kept per member in truss_members. Height 2.17 = 6.26 - 4.09 (main ridge).
Panel chain 1.00 + 1.25 x 6 = 8.50 is printed with no grid markers (floating chain in the grid master).
